sample_period_s.source: PROPOSED: default 10 Hz profiling cadence requested by T6; override with --period-s

throttle_period_s.source: PROPOSED: lower-rate 1 Hz VideoCore polling requested by T6; override with --throttle-period-s

camera_period_ms.source: PROPOSED: T6's stated 30 Hz frame budget

soft_temperature_limit_c.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED thermal boundary: Raspberry Pi says Pi 5 begins throttling when temperature reaches 80°C (https://www.raspberrypi.com/news/heating-and-cooling-raspberry-pi-5/); this check fails inclusively at >= 80°C.

throttle_bits_invalid.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED: vcgencmd get_throttled current and historical under-voltage/frequency-capped/throttled/soft-temperature bits documented in Raspberry Pi vcgencmd behavior and mirrored by tools/runtime_observer/resource_sampler.py

max_invalid_throttle_occurrences.source: PROPOSED: T6 requires that no under-voltage or throttling bit occur during a profiling window

percentile_method.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED: reused from tools/runtime_observer/stats.py; rank = ceil(q*n), one-indexed
